docs.label: ADR-0003
docs.title: Money is integer minor units
docs.context: Float arithmetic in the ledger accumulated a 37 EUR mismatch against settlement in January 2020.
docs.decision: All amounts are stored and computed as integer minor units. Conversion happens once, at the API boundary, in `payments/currency.py`.
docs.consequences: Never introduce a float amount into `payments/ledger.py`. Currencies without minor units (JPY) must go through the `MINOR_UNITS` table.

timeline.subject: fix: reconcile worker skipped refunds (#80)

why: Refunds are stored as negative entries and the worker only summed amount > 0, which caused a false mismatch on every refund day.
